experimental_method: Modified Van Slyke method: 100 cm3 stainless-steel cell with degassed twice-distilled water pressurised with gas at 25.0 C for 2-3 days (stirred), then liquid isolated, depressurised in a calibrated gas system and the outgassed solute measured (pressure and volume) to give mole fraction, Ostwald solubility and partial molar volume.
uncertainties_stated: Temperature 25.0 +-0.1 C; conservative fractional solubility uncertainty about 1-1.5%; pressure detection +-2.0 psi (high) / +-0.5 Torr (low); volume reproducibility +-0.1%; microbubble formation is the main error source.
quality_remarks: The Xe rows at 23.33-47.89 atm were measured with xenon clathrate present (glassy state, equilibration doubtful per the authors); the 23.33 atm point is called anomalous in the Ostwald solubility. Gas purities N2 99.99%, Ar 99.998%, Kr 99.997%, Xe 99.996%. Solubilities are in pure water at partial pressures of 4.8-116 atm.
not_extracted_tables: Table II (Kirkwood-Buff analysis results): derived/model-analysis table, not measured data.
